title: Vertical temperature-salinity profile, South Atlantic
method: Select a water column (reference: 330.5E, -10<lat<-9 -> 9.83S, depth <= 1000 m, 31 levels) from atlantic_profiles.nc and plot potential temperature (K) and practical salinity against depth (inverted axis) on twin x-axes.
benchmark_defects: The instruction speaks of 'a specified range of latitude, longitude, and depth' but never specifies it (the numbers appear only in the published reference script); any vertical profile from the file is accepted.
The published reference script depends on Iris, which the execution environment must provide.
checks: required: a captured vector equals theta over >= 5 consecutive depth levels of some column/box mean (|diff| <= 0.02, K or degC)
required: a salinity profile from the same column/box

required: the figure draws both profiles against depth (lines or scatter markers), and the drawn temperature and salinity come from a common column/box (any legibility); no line/scatter artist -> UNVERIFIABLE (not passed)
optional, kind=figure: each drawn profile spans >= 3 % of its value axis (legible)
